integrity: The proof derives each edge-distance code from the graph metric and characterizes resolution as injectivity of intersection with the landmark set. A separate checker computes graph distances by breadth-first search and tests every vertex subset through order ten, including the published K_{2,3,5} construction.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to ordinary vertex-based edge metric dimension on connected complete multipartite graphs of order at least three.
The complete-bipartite minimum-value branch is prior work; the correction concerns the published extension to three or more parts and adds an all-set classification.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased correction.
title: Correction and all-set classification for edge metric dimension of complete multipartite graphs
